programs.title: The Seed of the Sacred Fig
programs.desc: Tehran.Lawyer Iman (Missagh Zareh) is promoted to the position of investigating judge, which brings both financial benefits and a higher social status to his family, as well as a number of restrictive rules and obligations.Gradually, the man discovers the dark side of his new role - he is to approve death sentences for activists without fair trials.His nomination coincides with street protests following the death of a young woman detained by the police.The atmosphere in Iman's house becomes tense.The daughters, Rezvan (Mahsa Rostami) and Sana (Setareh Maleki), previously absorbed in school and friendships, begin to rebel more and more boldly against their father and the authority he represents and justifies.Najmeh's mother (Soheila Golestani) tries to calm the conflict.The situation becomes dramatic when Iman's service weapon disappears from his drawer... A moving story about the ethical dilemmas of ordinary people trapped in the gears of an authoritarian system.

programs.title: Welcome to Marwen
programs.desc: Mark Hogancamp (Steve Carell) is an illustrator, known primarily for his World War II graphics.However, he hides quite an original preference.He is fascinated by women's shoes.At home, she has a large collection of high heels, sandals, flip-flops and many other shoes.His secret is revealed unexpectedly and causes great emotions.He is attacked by a group of neo-Nazis.The injuries are so severe that they result in loss of not only memory, but also the ability to speak and move.His artistic career is ruined.The man starts therapy, hoping to regain his former shape.However, he struggles with enormous trauma and mental problems.He finally manages to find a new passion.He constructs a village in the garden, which he names Marwen.Its inhabitants, the dolls, are modeled on real people from his life.It turns out that the mockup helps him deal with panic attacks.However, he still cannot forget his experiences.Meanwhile, a new neighbor, Nicol (Leslie Mann), moves in next door.The film is inspired by the true story of artist Mark Hogancamp.The town he built is located in Kingston.

programs.title: The Inventor
programs.desc: The brilliant inventor Leonardo da Vinci cannot satisfy his enormous curiosity about the world.In search of inspiration, he leaves Italy and lives at the French court, where he can freely experiment by inventing flying machines, amazing vehicles and examining the human body.He comes up with the idea of ​​​​creating an ideal city and, together with the adventurous and bold Princess Margaret, tries to convince the ruler of his vision.Together they are also looking for answers about the meaning of life.However, the king expects something down-to-earth from the artist and researcher - he wants a large statue to show the world his power.

programs.title: Too big for fairy tales 2
programs.desc: Waldek (Maciej Karaś) is going to spend his holidays in the Tatra Mountains.A trip to Podhale with her mother's new partner, Piotr (Paweł Domagała), without access to the Internet and her favorite entertainment, computer games, does not inspire optimism.There, he will also meet his eccentric aunt (Dorota Kolak) again.Fortunately, he can take his friends, Staszek (Patryk Siemek) and Delfina (Amelia Fijałkowska), with him.Once there, the boy learns that his biological father (Michał Żurawski) lives nearby.He decides to sneak out of the house to find his parent, with whom he has had no contact so far.Many adventures await him on mountain trails.

programs.title: Esperando a Dalí
programs.desc: Barcelona, ​​1974, a period of intense opposition to Franco's dictatorship.Brothers Fernando (Ivan Massagué), a chef, and Alberto (Pol López), an activist, must hide from the authorities.They find shelter in Cadaqués, a picturesque seaside village that is also the home of the famous artist Salvador Dalí (Gal Soler).In this setting, the brothers meet Lola (Clara Ponsot), who helps them find work.Fernando, influenced by Dalí's works and his infatuation with women, finds a passion for creating unique dishes.The man's ambitions grow, especially when Jules (José Garcia), Lola's eccentric father, dreams of organizing a dinner for Dalí himself.Despite the difficulties, Fernando creates a culinary masterpiece that inspires a revolution in the world of taste, which leads to the creation of the famous Surreal restaurant.

programs.title: Twilight
programs.desc: Seventeen-year-old Bella Swan moves in with her father, who is the sheriff of a small town.At her new school, the teenager notices Edward Cullen.The unnaturally pale boy, who has the ability to read people's minds, is an inaccessible loner.Hoping that this will scare Bella away, Edward tells her that he is a vampire and that he and his entire family have been feeding on animal blood for centuries.This shocking truth does not discourage a girl in love.She and Cullen become inseparable.Their love, however, is threatened by a primal predatory instinct that is increasingly difficult for the boy to control.The couple is surrounded by wanderers hungry for human blood: Laurent, James and Victoria.The lovers face them.

programs.title: A Royal Christmas Tail
programs.desc: Riley runs a shelter for homeless animals.Fate puts in her path... a prince.

programs.title: A Real Pain
programs.desc: American David Kaplan (Jesse Eisenberg) and his cousin Benji (Kieran Culkin) set off on an expedition to Poland.They want to honor the memory of their beloved grandmother Dora.They begin their tour of her home country by joining the team of British guide James (Will Sharpe).Members of the group with Jewish roots visit places related to the history and culture of their ancestors.During the journey, tensions grow between the young men resulting from their different approaches to life.The director and screenwriter of the comedy-drama is Jesse Eisenberg, who also starred in the main role.He called his film "a love letter to Poland".His acting duo, Kieran Culkin, was awarded a Golden Globe.The photos were shot, among others, in Warsaw and Lublin.

programs.title: Druk
programs.desc: Denmark.Martin, Tommy, Peter and Nikolaj work as middle school teachers.They are burnt out and everyday life is taking its toll on them.During Nikolaj's birthday party, the men discuss the theory that humans are born with an alcohol deficit.Its small dose - only half a per mille in the blood - is supposed to increase their overall satisfaction.They decide to test it themselves and be excited every day.They quickly notice the positive effects - their family relationships improve, and they start to do better at work.Martin is finally able to communicate with his wife Anika and children, and the students finally listen to him with interest.Over time, however, it turns out that the initial dose is no longer enough for my friends and they start increasing it.They find that everything has its price.

programs.title: On Swift Horses
programs.desc: 1950s. Newlyweds Muriel (Daisy Edgar-Jones) and Lee (Will Poulter) move from Kansas to San Diego, where a new home and job awaits them.At this time, the man's brother, Julius (Jacob Elordi), who has just returned from the Korean War, reappears in their lives.The former veteran is an accomplished poker player.So he goes to Las Vegas, where he supervises a casino and becomes friends with another gaming enthusiast, Henry (Diego Calva).All this time, she corresponds by letter with her sister-in-law.The woman, bored with her everyday life, is fascinated by the world of gambling in which her brother-in-law operates.Under his influence, he secretly begins betting on horse races.She soon leaves her husband and sets off on an exciting journey together with his brother.

programs.title: The Bride!
programs.desc: Chicago, 1930s. At the request of Frankenstein (Christian Bale), researcher Dr. Euphronious (Annette Bening) resurrects for him a woman (Jessie Buckley), a murder victim, pulled out of the grave.An odd couple like Bonny and Clyde quickly attracts trouble and has to flee the city.Detective Jake (Peter Sarsgaard) follows them, with his assistant Myrna (Penelope Cruz) helping him at every step.The revived dead woman and her companion cause chaos wherever they appear.Together they commit robberies and murders, and over time, the two outcasts develop a fiery romance.Mary Shelley, possessed by the voice of the writer, seeks destruction, but at the same time frees herself from the corset of social conventions.An ambitious reinterpretation of a horror classic with elements of Victorian horror and burlesque.

programs.title: Freaky
programs.desc: Millie (Kathryn Newton) lives in a small American town and struggles with numerous problems.He can only count on a pair of loyal friends, Josh (Misha Osherovich) and Nyla (Celeste O'Connor).She is ridiculed by her peers and has just lost her father.To make matters worse, he becomes the target of a psychopath roaming the area, the Blissfield Butcher (Vince Vaughn).The bloody incident has surprising consequences - the girl, stabbed with an antique dagger on a moonlit night, magically switches bodies with her tormentor.In the morning he wakes up as a wanted murderer, and the Butcher can now go hunting in the form of a delicate blonde.Millie has only 24 hours to reverse the spell.Christopher Landon, the creator of "Die Another Day", pays tribute to the classics of horror cinema.He skillfully plays with convention, referring to "Halloween" or "Scream".
